mask_provenance.sar_valid_mask_description: Binary sensory raster recording physical SAR observation validity (1=valid swath data, 0=nodata/margin). Strictly independent of ground-truth labels.
mask_provenance.label_description: Ground truth land cover and flood annotation raster. Label value 3 denotes unannotated/invalid ground-truth pixels.
mask_provenance.adaptation_mask_definition: valid = (MK0_MNA == 1). Strictly NO ground-truth labels and NO label-3 exclusion during adaptation.
mask_provenance.offline_evaluation_mask_definition: valid = (MK0_MNA == 1) & (MK0_MLU != 3). Strictly confined to offline evaluation of frozen predictions.

source_only_control_plan.description: 6 matched source-only physical streams executed fresh under identical B=16 dataloader, preprocessing, checkpoints, and evaluation conventions (3 seeds x 2 orders).
source_only_control_plan.reuse_across_resets: After verifying model state immutability, these 6 physical stream results are explicitly reused across reset_per_event and continual modes, populating the 12 logical source-only matrix cells.

order_a.description: Canonical chronological / ascending event ID sequence with ascending sample IDs

order_b.description: Reversed event sequence with descending sample IDs
order_b.causal_scope: Tests combined event-sequence and within-event sample ordering sensitivity, not their separate causal effects.

reset_per_event.description: Episodic adaptation: full state restoration to source checkpoint before every event

continual.description: Continual adaptation: parameters, running buffers, and optimizer state persist across event boundaries

adabn.bn_mode: train (updates running stats via batch stats)

tent.bn_mode: train (non-BN modules frozen, track_running_stats=False, running_mean=None, running_var=None)
tent.adaptation_mask: sar_valid_mask_only (MK0_MNA == 1; strictly no GT label info)
tent.forward_pass_mechanics: Single forward pass computes logits and entropy loss; one Adam step updates BN affine parameters; predictions returned are those from that single forward pass without a second post-update forward.

stream_execution_policy.partial_batch_policy_note: All samples are retained with no dropped samples. Expected tail batch sizes across events are [13, 9, 12, 10, 3, 11], so no singleton (N=1) tail batch is expected. However, runtime numerical health checks remain strictly required during execution.
stream_execution_policy.label_isolation: Strictly zero ground-truth labels and zero label-derived masks during adaptation. Offline evaluation must not influence updates, stopping, or parameter selection.

decision_framework.gate_a2_scope: Assesses reproducible harmful adaptation under the declared conditions. Does NOT establish risk-prediction quality, controller effectiveness, or final viability of the project topic.
decision_framework.reproducible_harm_criterion: The same event is harmed (delta F1 <= -0.01) for the same method and reset mode in at least two of three checkpoint seeds under BOTH stream orders (Order A and Order B).
decision_framework.benefit_reporting: Reported separately for scientific characterization; benefit is NOT required to establish the existence of harmful adaptation.

outcome_categories.harm_observed: Reproducible harm observed under declared operational criteria.
outcome_categories.harm_not_established: Reproducible harm not established under tested conditions. (Absence of observed harm does not infer universal safety.)
outcome_categories.inconclusive: Incomplete or inconclusive evidence due to numerical failure, interruption, or execution defect.

decision_framework.numerical_safeguard_note: Numerical failures (NaN/Inf) are treated as execution failures and must NOT be counted as measured performance degradation.
